build_SpeechEncoder_by_name: build a SpeechEncoder from pre-trained dense and quantizer model names with a given vocab size
encode_waveform_with_SpeechEncoder_forwa: encode a raw audio waveform into discrete unit tokens, durations, and optional F0 pitch stream
resample_audio_maybe_resample: resample an audio waveform to the expected sample rate of the SpeechEncoder dense model
get_streams_function: extract unit tokens, durations, F0, and dense features from a waveform using a dense and quantizer model
configure_SpeechEncoder_deduplicate_bos_: configure a SpeechEncoder to deduplicate repeated tokens with run-length encoding and add BOS/EOS boundary tokens
